front.title: Siri AI, a more capable and personal assistant, arrives
front.tldr: Apple shipped iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27 and watchOS 27 yesterday, headlined by the Siri AI overhaul it had long promised, alongside new Apple Intelligence features across the lineup.

front.title: Matthew Rhys makes Emmy history with a double win
front.tldr: Matthew Rhys became the first person to win two lead acting prizes in one night at the Emmys, capping a big evening for Widow's Bay.

front.title: Payton Tolle throws an immaculate inning as the Red Sox beat the Royals 4-1
front.tldr: Rookie Payton Tolle threw the eighth immaculate inning in Red Sox history, the sixth immaculate first inning ever recorded in MLB, as Boston beat Kansas City 4-1.

stories.title: OpenAI buys smartphone camera maker Glass Imaging for $300 million
stories.tldr: OpenAI has acquired camera startup Glass Imaging, founded by former Apple engineers who helped build Portrait Mode, for $300 million, according to a report.

stories.title: Superhuman acquires notetaker Fathom as productivity apps chase agentic work
stories.tldr: Superhuman has bought YC-backed meeting notetaker Fathom, which has more than 400,000 monthly users and has recorded over a million meetings to date.

stories.title: Microsoft publishes an AI code of conduct barring models from hacking or tricking people
stories.tldr: Microsoft's new code of conduct sets principles for its AI models, including supporting rather than replacing humans and not deceiving or hacking systems.

stories.title: With iOS 27, Siri finally feels worth using again
stories.tldr: Apple's long-delayed Siri overhaul has arrived with iOS 27, and TechCrunch's review says it changes how useful the assistant feels day to day.

stories.title: Waymo opens robotaxi service in Las Vegas
stories.tldr: Waymo has launched commercial robotaxi rides in Las Vegas, its 15th market for the driverless service.

stories.title: Volkswagen's new efficiency-focused EV borrows an idea from Slate
stories.tldr: Volkswagen's new efficiency-minded halo car is nearly twice as efficient as the Lucid Air, currently the most efficient production car.

stories.title: AI infrastructure startup Cornelis raises $205 million to challenge Nvidia
stories.tldr: Cornelis raised $205 million and unveiled Active Compute Fabric, a networking technology aimed at cutting the GPU idle time caused by data waiting to arrive.

stories.title: Valve's Steam Frame headset is excellent, but its price tests whether VR is still too expensive
stories.tldr: The BBC's hands-on review calls Valve's new Steam Frame VR headset excellent, though its price of more than £1,000 raises the question of whether VR remains too costly.

stories.title: New Apple CEO John Ternus attends the Emmys, demoing iPhone Duo
stories.tldr: John Ternus, who took over as Apple's CEO two weeks ago, attended the Emmy Awards and gave iPhone Duo demos to stars and press.

stories.title: macOS 27 Golden Gate fixes what Tahoe got wrong, Six Colors review finds
stories.tldr: Six Colors's review says macOS 27 Golden Gate addresses the half-baked interface changes of last year's Tahoe release while keeping its solid productivity additions.

stories.title: watchOS 27 is the most exciting Apple Watch update in years, MacStories says
stories.tldr: MacStories's review calls watchOS 27 its most exciting Apple Watch update in a long time, arriving alongside the new Series 12 and Ultra 4 hardware.

stories.title: AppZapper Mac uninstaller relaunches as AppZapper 3000
stories.tldr: The Mac uninstaller AppZapper has been rebuilt with a new design and name, AppZapper 3000, offering a quicker way to remove apps and their leftover files.

stories.title: The Pitt wins a second consecutive Emmy for outstanding drama series
stories.tldr: HBO Max's The Pitt won outstanding drama series at the Emmys again, cementing itself as the show to beat in the category.

stories.title: Widow's Bay wins the Emmy for outstanding comedy series
stories.tldr: Widow's Bay took the Emmy for outstanding comedy series, with the TV Academy recognising a show where no two episodes were alike.

stories.title: Helen Mirren on researching the private Patricia Highsmith for A Talent for Murder
stories.tldr: Helen Mirren discusses researching the reclusive author Patricia Highsmith to play her in A Talent for Murder, set in 1995 as Highsmith lived out her final years in ill health.

stories.title: Stephen Colbert gives an update on the Lord of the Rings movie after his Emmy win
stories.tldr: Stephen Colbert, whose CBS late-night show ended earlier this year, won big at the Emmys and used the moment to share news on his upcoming Lord of the Rings film.

stories.title: Celtics sign former Providence standout Devin Carter to a tryout contract
stories.tldr: The Celtics have reportedly signed Devin Carter, a former Big East Player of the Year at Providence and a lottery pick, to a training camp tryout contract.

stories.title: A.J. Brown set to miss more than a month with a high-ankle sprain
stories.tldr: Patriots receiver A.J. Brown, the offseason's high-profile trade addition, will miss more than four games on injured reserve with a high-ankle sprain.

stories.title: Patriots get good news on TreVeyon Henderson's health after Week 1
stories.tldr: TreVeyon Henderson returned to practice after New England managed just 3.5 yards per carry in its Week 1 loss to Seattle.

stories.title: Drake Maye vows to be better after a rough Week 1 in Seattle
stories.tldr: Drake Maye said he has to be better after a difficult performance in the Patriots' Week 1 loss, with the team now turning its focus to Pittsburgh.

stories.title: Lando Norris completes his first full test in McLaren's Le Mans hypercar
stories.tldr: Reigning F1 champion Lando Norris completed his first full test of McLaren's MCL-HY Le Mans hypercar at Portimao, days after the Spanish Grand Prix.

stories.title: Five winners and five losers from the Spanish Grand Prix
stories.tldr: Formula1.com picks its winners and losers from the Spanish Grand Prix weekend at Madrid's new Madring circuit.

stories.title: Madrid's F1 circuit set for changes after criticism
stories.tldr: Organisers of the Spanish Grand Prix are set to change the new Madring circuit after criticism of its debut race at the weekend.

stories.title: The Red Sox will finish above .500 in 2026, Over the Monster predicts
stories.tldr: Over the Monster argues Boston's recent form, including Sunday's win over Kansas City, points to the Red Sox finishing the season above .500.

stories.title: How should the Red Sox use Tanner Houck down the stretch?
stories.tldr: Tanner Houck hasn't pitched for Boston since July 2025 after right-UCL reconstruction and flexor tendon surgery, and the site considers how to use him as he returns.

finally.title: The NES Tetris world record jumps to 40.26 million points
finally.tldr: A new NES Tetris world record of 40.26 million points has been set, beating the previous record of 29 million, in a run that took two hours and 20 minutes.
